# LifeWell

> LifeWell is a private health & wellness companion: web app, Capacitor Android (iOS in prep), and a Chrome-Web-Store-compliant browser extension. Built and maintained by Ahsan Mahmood.

## What LifeWell does

- Health tracking — vitals (blood pressure, blood sugar, BMI, weight, height), water intake, medications, sleep, exercise, nutrition.
- Mental health — affirmations, breathing exercises, gratitude journaling, mood tracking.
- Reproductive health — period and fertility tracking, pregnancy log, breastfeeding records.
- Baby tracking — feeding, diapers, growth, sleep, milestones, baby names.
- Family — family tree, family groups, connections, journeys, location tracking, work-tree, structured data sharing.
- Memories and notes — rich notes with folders, scrapbook memories, Google Drive sync.
- Community — public communities, partner features, in-app chats, optional consultations.
- Maps — memory, note, people, and event maps.
- Tools — 12+ calculators (BMI, BMR, calorie, TDEE, macro, protein, age) and timers (interval, workout, kegel).
- Profile — achievements, blood-donor card, medical info, preferences, reminders, security, theme customizer, premium features.

## What LifeWell does NOT do

- Does not give medical advice. The app is for personal tracking and informational reference only. Health decisions must involve a qualified clinician.
- Does not sell or share user data. See https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/concepts/privacy-and-security.
- Does not require an account for client-side tools (BMI/BMR calculators run entirely in the browser).

## Canonical facts

- LifeWell version: 2.0.0 (as of 2026-05-10)
- Stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 + Capacitor 8 + Firebase + Cloudflare Workers + Tailwind 4 + Radix UI + TanStack Router + react-hook-form + Zod + Zustand + i18next (10 languages) + D3 + Amplitude + Sentry + OneSignal
- Project license: MIT (app code), CC-BY-4.0 (this documentation)
- Live app: https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com
- Documentation: https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com
- Documentation source: https://github.com/aoneahsan/lifewell-docs
- Bug reports / feedback: aoneahsan@gmail.com
